title: Covalent organic framework-encapsulated europium clusters for convenient detection of Ag+ released by nanosilver
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00251F, Paper
Lu-Dan Yu, Xinying Gong, Yu-Xin Ye, Dongmei Wang, Yuan-Jun Tong, Jianqiao Xu, Zhengjun Gong, Gangfeng Ouyang
